title: NGA — Map of the World (MoW) Modernization
goal: Align UX strategy with platform outcomes; provide artifacts that accelerate delivery.
summary: Re-architected flows, IA, onboarding, and admin models; installed an owned feedback path from UX to DevOps for durable prioritization.

sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
Role: Senior UX Engineer (manager-level scope)
Domain: Enterprise Geospatial
Scope: Research, IA, high-fi wireframes, onboarding & admin models, feedback path
Team: [X UX, Y PM/Eng squads, Z SMEs]
Timeframe: [Q#/Year – Q#/Year]

sections.title: Goal & Constraints
sections.body: Align UX with platform outcomes, reduce friction across core tasks, and create a durable path for user signals to inform prioritization and roadmapping.

sections.title: What I Led
sections.body:
• Org & Ops — Cross-team alignment; research instruments (data calls, questionnaires); feedback-loop SOP.
• Research & Insights — SME interviews; usage pain-point review; onboarding friction analysis.
• Product & IA — Re-architected IA/navigation; analyst/admin task models; admin theming model.
• Design & Systems — High-fidelity wireframes; onboarding wizard; embedded guidance patterns.
• Delivery & Quality — Outcome scorecards; acceptance criteria tied to task outcomes.
• Stakeholders & Decisions — Vision workshops; prioritization forums; roadmap alignment checkpoints.

sections.title: Research & Discovery
sections.body: We created systematic data-collection instruments and consolidated anecdotal pain points into signals usable by product and engineering.

sections.title: Mental Models → IA
sections.body: Analyst/admin task models drove a re-architecture of navigation and page hierarchy; themes and onboarding steps reduce cognitive load and ramp time.

sections.title: Information Architecture
sections.body: Admin theming lets teams tailor visibility to the work at hand; analyst surfaces emphasize context, lineage, and action.

sections.title: Prototypes (Hi-Fi)
sections.body: Key flows across analyst and admin surfaces, an onboarding wizard, and contextual help patterns embedded in complex workflows.

sections.title: Operating Mechanisms
sections.body: Outcome scorecards, decision memos, and an explicitly owned feedback path tie releases to measurable improvements rather than output volume.

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.body:
Clearer task pathways; faster alignment; improved build readiness; reduced friction through embedded guidance.
Ranges: Task success [↑ ~X–Y%] · Onboarding time [↓ ~X–Y%] · Support tickets [↓ ~X–Y%]
